verdict.rationale: The Division publishes its own step-by-step videos for registration, certification, apostille and PBS account setup. It also has a 'Getting Registered' page that walks founders through sequential filings toward a Business Registration Certificate, and its service descriptions are written in plain task language rather than statute citations. The depth and readability of these explainers are not shown, and some content still leans on form numbers (CD-100/CD-101). Missing for 10: evidence of written plain-language explainers per task (formation, annual reports, dissolution), detail on what the videos and guides actually cover, and independent confirmation that non-lawyers find them followable.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: Need help with filing for registration, certification, ordering an Apostille or setting up a Premier Business Services (PBS) account? Watch our step-by-step videos
Once you have successfully completed the two filings above, you will be able to obtain a Business Registration Certificate (BRC) for public contracting
When you have already formed/authorized your business in NJ and need to register for tax and employer purposes
